These are synthetic, anonymous Riot Match-v5-shaped fixtures, not captured live API responses. `mayhem-match.json` uses queue 2400 (ARAM Mayhem), no Summoner’s Rift positions, and ordinary Match-v5 statistics/loadouts. Its map ID is illustrative and is deliberately not used to identify Mayhem. Riot augment fields and a reliable remake indicator are unverified: adapters return null rather than invent their shape or infer remake from duration. Later pages containing only unsupported/missing match details return history: null with warnings and a consumed-ID cursor; upstream errors other than a missing match abort the page.


`lab-timeline.js` exports synthetic Summoner’s Rift match/timeline bodies with an intentionally shuffled participant mapping (selected participant ID 7), irregular frame timestamps, missing/zero fields in test variants, and same-timestamp kill/item events. Contract checked against [Riot MATCH-V5](https://developer.riotgames.com/api-details/match-v5) on 2026-10-05. The official timeline DTO documents participant ID/PUUID mappings, timestamped frames and economy/XP fields; event-specific kill/item/objective fields are exercised by fixtures, not verified live in this task. These fixtures do not establish live timeline availability or prove match provenance.

`lcu-mayhem-game.json` is a real ARAM Mayhem game (queue 2400, `gameMode: "KIWI"`) read from the League client's local API (`/lol-match-history/v1/games/{gameId}`) on 2026-10-20, then anonymised: PUUIDs, account and summoner IDs, Riot IDs, profile icons, game ID and creation time are replaced. Gameplay statistics, champions, items, spells and `playerAugment1..6` are unchanged. The importing player is participant 1 (`fixture-puuid-self`).
